title: FLUX.2 klein
description: Text-to-image and multi-reference image editing with FLUX.2 klein 4B. Apache-2.0 weights, no API keys, and a working endpoint with nothing configured.

input.name: Model
input.description: Which FLUX.2 klein 4B profile to serve. Everything else — sampler, steps, guidance, text encoder, VAE — follows from this choice. Only the default is baked into the image; the others download once on first boot.

options.label: klein 4B distilled, fp8 — fast, baked in (default)
klein 4B distilled, bf16 — full precision, 7.8 GB download
klein 4B distilled, NVFP4 — Blackwell GPUs only
klein 4B base, fp8 — slower, better prompt adherence
klein 4B base, bf16 — quality ceiling, 7.8 GB download

input.name: Sampling steps
input.description: Steps for requests that do not specify their own. Leave empty to follow the profile: 4 for the distilled models, 50 for the base ones. The distilled models are trained to converge at 4, so raising it there changes the image rather than improving it and costs proportionally more GPU time. A request may always override this per image.

input.name: Text encoder precision
input.description: Qwen3-4B in bf16 (8.0 GB, baked in) or fp4 (3.8 GB, downloads once). The encoder sets the memory floor for every profile, so fp4 is the only lever that lowers it.

input.name: Where weights come from
input.description: auto tries the image, then a network volume, then Hugging Face. The explicit values turn that fallback off, so a production deployment can assert its assumption instead of discovering a multi-gigabyte download in its bill.

options.label: auto — image, then volume, then download
baked — fail if not in the image
volume — fail if not on the network volume
download — always fetch from Hugging Face

input.name: Default width
input.description: Used when a request does not specify one.

input.name: Default height
input.description: Used when a request does not specify one.

input.name: Maximum output pixels
input.description: Ceiling on width x height. Lower it to keep a shared endpoint predictable.

input.name: Maximum images per request
input.description: Upper bound on the n field.

input.name: Maximum reference images
input.description: Can lower the profile's own limit, never raise it.

input.name: Reference image pixel budget
input.description: Each reference is downscaled to fit this before encoding. References enter the transformer context, so this drives both memory and latency.

input.name: Default output format
input.description: Per-request output_format overrides this.

input.name: Default output quality
input.description: Applies to WebP and JPEG.

input.name: S3 endpoint URL
input.description: Optional. Leave empty to get images back as base64, which is a fully supported production setup. Set all three S3 fields together or none of them.

input.name: S3 access key ID
input.description: Optional. Only needed if you set an S3 endpoint.

input.name: S3 secret access key
input.description: Optional. Only needed if you set an S3 endpoint.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Not needed for any built-in profile — every model this worker ships is public and Apache-2.0. Only relevant if you point the expert overrides below at a gated repository.

input.name: Custom diffusion model repo
input.description: Expert override. Set together with the file field. You are responsible for the licence and the compatibility of anything you point this at.

input.name: Custom diffusion model file
input.description: Path inside the repository. Must be .safetensors; there is no GGUF loader in this image.

input.name: Custom text encoder repo
input.description: Expert override. Set together with the file field.

input.name: Custom text encoder file
input.description: Path inside the repository.

input.name: Custom VAE repo
input.description: Expert override. Set together with the file field.

input.name: Custom VAE file
input.description: Path inside the repository.
